gap: No result ChatGPT got states that XGIMI's US store sells the MoGo 4 with its PowerBase Stand (5 h claimed playtime) for $519. That is $40 more than the bare $479 MoGo 4 (2.5 h) and $89 less than buying the $129 stand separately, which puts a 5-hour MoGo 4 at the same price as ChatGPT's 'approximately $520' Nebula Mars 3 Air.
standout_why: I opened a2zcheck (rank 3, 2026-11-02). It prices the MoGo 4 Laser at €749 in the EU and mentions an optional stand that extends battery life, but gives no stand price, no bundle price, no US prices and no total cost with accessories. ChatGPT's answer lists the MoGo 4 at $479 and the MoGo 4 Laser at $669 with no bundle. The Wirecutter page (the only cited result) could not be read: nytimes.com blocked the fetch, and the proxy URL ChatGPT used now returns a message from the proxy's owner asking people to stop using it. The RTINGS and TechRadar pages loaded without their product sections, so I could not check what they list.
decides: This confirms the XGIMI MoGo 4 as the all-round pick and makes it the battery pick too. For $519 at XGIMI US it has a claimed 5 h of video, so it can play a full film away from a wall socket. The bare MoGo 4, MoGo 4 Laser and Capsule 3 are all rated at about 2.5 h. The MoGo 4 Laser ($669, same as ChatGPT's Walmart price) costs $150 more than the bundle and still has 2.5 h unless you also buy the stand. Two rows on our page need fixing. The Dangbei N2 Smart Projector is sold out at Dangbei US (its $199 N2 mini is in stock). The Aurzen ZIP's dongle is now the $129.99 CastPlay Pro, so the ZIP costs $389.98 in total with the dongle, within about $10 of the Capsule 3.
